column1: # script-VM nullable object push adapters - EC-7 family C, declared on this directory's page
# RESTRICTED to the body sizes that carry the shared idiom. The tag chose the
# candidates; the bytes chose the members.

# Shape: one idiom: load the pointed-to object, branch to a null push when it is null, otherwise add the member offset and push. The sub-shapes differ only in that offset immediate (none, 8, 1, 0x30, 0x10).
# Control: all 295 reach the same three targets - 00684080, 0080F420 and 00810620 - EXACTLY 295 times each, one per member.

#   four members are different idioms and are excluded: 0063D010 (71 B) and 0063D3C0 (68 B) take a DYNAMIC offset from the class descriptor at [rcx+0xF4] rather than a constant; 006A9D10 (57 B) loads a further indirection; 0079A6C0 (91 B) makes a virtual call and moves 16 bytes
# NOT dispositioned: the shared implementations these members jump or call into, and
# whatever object or member each adapter names.
# One function entry address per line, VA (image base 0x00120000 included).
